body:
**Spidey and His Amazing Friends S5 (tvdb 404491, Sonarr series 1049): every two-segment file sits on the wrong episodes.** Found during the #936 live check, 2026-10-13. The Title Check missed these because their verdicts are `ambiguous` or `silent`, not `disagrees`. Evidence: each file's own subtitle stream, read with ffprobe in the Sonarr pod (read-only, `nice -n 19`). Each file is 24:05 long, so one broadcast of two TVDB segments.

| Episode file | Sonarr has it on | Its subtitles open with | So it holds |
|---|---|---|---|
| 64846 (LAZY `S05E01E02`) | E01-E02 | "Lights, Sirens, Action!", "Symbie's Slimy Scheme!" | E01, E02 (right) |
| 64849 (DOLORES `S05E03`) | E03 | "Remote-controlled Zola.", "Super Cat." | E05, E06 |
| 64847 (DOLORES `S05E04`) | E04 | "Sandman's Mountain Mayhem", "Puffer Fish Problems" | E07, E08 |
| 72095 (LAZY `S05E03E04`) | E05-E08 | "One fantastic surprise party.", "Kitty Cat Chaos." | E03, E04 |
| 72195 (LAZY `S05E05E06`) | E09-E12 | "Remote-controlled Zola.", "Super Cat." | E05, E06: a second copy of 64849 |

The right state: E03-E04 get 72095, E05-E06 get 64849 (or 72195), and E07-E08 get 64847. E09-E20 have no file. 72195 is a second copy.

Plex view counts are 0 for every S5 episode on HaynesTower and PlexOps (read 15:58Z). Plex shows each multi-episode file only on its first episode.

The Season Re-map cannot do this: `--place` needs equal-length ranges, and these files shrink from four episodes to two. It needs hand ManualImports, like the other two-segment files in section 5.

Related: v0.120.0's two-episode Release Pick filed RBB's untitled `S05E09E10` (E09 and E10 content) on E17 to E20, because of Sonarr's scene mapping. Staff deleted it at 15:56Z and read it back, so E17 to E20 are missing again. #945 stops the Release Pick from offering a renumbered multi-episode release.
